o: Season 2 continues with the heroic mutant team of X-Men, divided and thrown across different eras in time as they struggle to navigate their return home. Meanwhile, back in the 1990s, suspicious foes and new strains of mutant intolerance are on the rise in the wake of the X-Men's absence.

v.n: A Message to X-Men '97 Fans - Stream Season 2 Now On Disney+

eps.o: Forge and Bishop launch an ambitious plan to rescue the X-Men who have been scattered through time.

eps.t: A Force to Be Reckoned With
eps.o: After E-Day, a covert paramilitary force rises to try to fill the void left by the X-Men.
The plan to rescue the team from Ancient Egypt is turned upside-down by an unexpected visitor.
An alliance between the X-Men and En Sabah Nur starts to crack when Rama-Tut seeks ultimate power.
Wolverine, Morph, and a motley crew of old rivals face off against Weapon X's latest experiment.
Former X-Man Polaris returns to Xavier's mansion just as a new threat emerges on campus.
The X-Men travel to the Savage Land and are surprised to find a familiar face.
The X-Men confront a ghost from their past.
The X-Men are pushed to their limits as their past comes back to haunt them.
